summary: Replaced inactive catalog controls with versioned product and discount CRUD, archive/restore, confirmed history-aware deletion, literal search and retained editor drafts.
Added bounded validated local persistence, Web Locks and raw-baseline conflict detection, explicit reviewed backup replacement and corrupt-byte recovery without touching legacy cart data.
Implemented exact-cent quantities and discounts, immutable simulated receipt snapshots, request-key replay after lost acknowledgement, cancellation and paginated searchable receipt history.

Preserved the original visual palette and fictional collection, removed unsupported payment/tax/fulfillment claims, fixed text navigation at narrow widths, and added nine detailed learning documents with six reviewed screenshots.

checks.environment: Node 22.16.0, TypeScript 6.0.3, React 19.2.6, Vite 8.0.14; Chromium 148 in isolated profiles
checks.command: npm.cmd test; npm.cmd run build; python scripts/verify_browser.py

limits: Browser-only local simulation without accounts, server authorization, SQL, payments, recurring billing, taxes, stock, refunds or delivery.
Cooperative Web Locks and localStorage do not protect against other scripts or profile access; no full accessibility, all-browser, power-loss or deployment certification.
Whole JSON workspace is bounded to 4 MiB, 1000 products, 200 codes and 2000 receipts; all writes use a conservative whole-workspace baseline.

Cart, editor and retry drafts remain in tab memory; exports are for manual review, not automatic draft import. Abandoning an uncertain request and using a new key can create another receipt. Backup replacement can remove current records absent from the backup.
